accepted.evidence: Turner 43 gives Pashai aᵉċ and neighboring Shumashti aĩċ “eye” under ákṣi. Lehr Darrai ainc preserves the same nasalized eye stem, with source n/c notation. Exact raw Lehr row and persistent compiled identity checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 9560 gives neighboring Shumashti bō̃zil, Gawarbati banzíl and Waigali bōǰī́l “earthquake” under bhūmicala. Lehr Darrai bonjil has the diagnostic b-n-j-l sequence and exact sense. Exact raw Lehr row and persistent compiled identity checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 540 gives Pashai awatā́ and neighboring Shumashti awata “hungry” under abhukta, while explicitly allowing an ábhakta alternative. Lehr Darrai aoti has the same hungry stem; the deeper alternative remains unresolved. Exact raw Lehr row and persistent compiled identity checked; no import or transcription change.
